verdict.rationale: Okta's Cross App Access (XAA) is explicitly designed to let AI agents/apps act on a user's behalf via OIDC without exposing raw credentials, addressing scoped delegated access, and Okta provides a free dev playground and blog documentation for building these agent-to-app connections. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of actual scope granularity enforcement, and no explicit mention of a dedicated 'least-privilege API key' issuance flow beyond OIDC-based XAA.
